segments.an6.16:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bhaggesu viharati susumāragire [suṃsumāragire (sī. pī.), saṃsumāragire (katthaci)] bhesakaḷāvane migadāye.
segments.an6.16:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena nakulapitā gahapati ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
segments.an6.16:1.3: Atha kho nakulamātā gahapatānī nakulapitaraṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca –
segments.an6.16:2.1: “Mā kho tvaṃ, gahapati, sāpekkho [sāpekho (pī. ka.)] kālamakāsi.
segments.an6.16:2.4: Siyā kho pana te, gahapati, evamassa –
segments.an6.16:2.5: ‘na nakulamātā gahapatānī mamaccayena sakkhissati [na sakkhissati (sī. syā. kaṃ.), sakkoti (pī. ka.)] dārake posetuṃ, gharāvāsaṃ sandharitun’ti [sandharitunti (ka.), saṇṭharituṃ (syā.)].
segments.an6.16:2.6: Na kho panetaṃ, gahapati, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.an6.16:2.7: Kusalāhaṃ, gahapati, kappāsaṃ kantituṃ veṇiṃ olikhituṃ.
segments.an6.16:2.8: Sakkomahaṃ, gahapati, tavaccayena dārake posetuṃ, gharāvāsaṃ sandharituṃ.
segments.an6.16:2.9: Tasmātiha tvaṃ, gahapati, mā sāpekkho kālamakāsi.
segments.an6.16:3.2: ‘nakulamātā gahapatānī mamaccayena aññaṃ gharaṃ [bhattāraṃ (syā. kaṃ.), vīraṃ (sī.)] gamissatī’ti.
segments.an6.16:3.3: Na kho panetaṃ, gahapati, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.an6.16:3.4: Tvañceva kho, gahapati, jānāsi ahañca, yaṃ no [yadā te (sī.), yathā (syā.), yathā no (pī.)] soḷasavassāni gahaṭṭhakaṃ brahmacariyaṃ samāciṇṇaṃ [samādinnaṃ (sī.)].
segments.an6.16:3.5: Tasmātiha tvaṃ, gahapati, mā sāpekkho kālamakāsi.
segments.an6.16:4.2: ‘nakulamātā gahapatānī mamaccayena na dassanakāmā bhavissati bhagavato na dassanakāmā bhikkhusaṅghassā’ti.
segments.an6.16:4.3: Na kho panetaṃ, gahapati, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.an6.16:4.4: Ahañhi, gahapati, tavaccayena dassanakāmatarā ceva bhavissāmi bhagavato, dassanakāmatarā ca bhikkhusaṅghassa.
segments.an6.16:4.5: Tasmātiha tvaṃ, gahapati, mā sāpekkho kālamakāsi.
segments.an6.16:5.2: ‘na nakulamātā gahapatānī mamaccayena sīlesu [nakulamātā … na sīlesu (sī. pī.)] paripūrakārinī’ti.
segments.an6.16:5.3: Na kho panetaṃ, gahapati, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.an6.16:5.4: Yāvatā kho, gahapati, tassa bhagavato sāvikā gihī odātavasanā sīlesu paripūrakāriniyo, ahaṃ tāsaṃ aññatarā.
segments.an6.16:5.5: Yassa kho panassa kaṅkhā vā vimati vā – ayaṃ so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhaggesu viharati susumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye – taṃ bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā pucchatu.
segments.an6.16:5.6: Tasmātiha tvaṃ, gahapati, mā sāpekkho kālamakāsi.
segments.an6.16:6.2: ‘na nakulamātā gahapatānī lābhinī [nakulamātā gahapatānī na lābhinī (pī.)] ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassā’ti.
segments.an6.16:6.3: Na kho panetaṃ, gahapati, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.an6.16:6.4: Yāvatā kho, gahapati, tassa bhagavato sāvikā gihī odātavasanā lābhiniyo ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa, ahaṃ tāsaṃ aññatarā.
segments.an6.16:6.5: Yassa kho panassa kaṅkhā vā vimati vā – ayaṃ so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhaggesu viharati susumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye – taṃ bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā pucchatu.
segments.an6.16:6.6: Tasmātiha tvaṃ, gahapati, mā sāpekkho kālamakāsi.
segments.an6.16:7.2: ‘na nakulamātā gahapatānī imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ogādhappattā patigādhappattā assāsappattā tiṇṇavicikicchā vigatakathaṃkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā satthusāsane viharatī’ti.
segments.an6.16:7.3: Na kho panetaṃ, gahapati, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.an6.16:7.4: Yāvatā kho, gahapati, tassa bhagavato sāvikā gihī odātavasanā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ogādhappattā patigādhappattā assāsappattā tiṇṇavicikicchā vigatakathaṃkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā satthusāsane viharanti, ahaṃ tāsaṃ aññatarā.
segments.an6.16:7.5: Yassa kho panassa kaṅkhā vā vimati vā – ayaṃ so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhaggesu viharati susumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye – taṃ bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā pucchatu.
segments.an6.16:7.6: Tasmātiha tvaṃ, gahapati, mā sāpekkho kālamakāsi.
segments.an6.16:8.1: Atha kho nakulapituno gahapatissa nakulamātarā [nakulamātāya (sī. syā.), nakulamātuyā (ka.)] gahapatāniyā iminā ovādena ovadiyamānassa so ābādho ṭhānaso paṭippassambhi.
segments.an6.16:8.2: Vuṭṭhahi [vuṭṭhāti (ka.)] ca nakulapitā gahapati tamhā ābādhā;
segments.an6.16:8.3: tathā pahīno ca pana nakulapituno gahapatissa so ābādho ahosi.
segments.an6.16:8.4: Atha kho nakulapitā gahapati gilānā vuṭṭhito [“gilānabhāvato vuṭṭhāya ṭhito, bhāvappadhāno hi ayaṃ niddeso”ti ṭīkāsaṃvaṇṇanā] aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā daṇḍamolubbha yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho nakulapitaraṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.an6.16:9.2: Yassa te nakulamātā gahapatānī anukampikā atthakāmā ovādikā anusāsikā.
segments.an6.16:9.3: Yāvatā kho, gahapati, mama sāvikā gihī odātavasanā sīlesu paripūrakāriniyo, nakulamātā gahapatānī tāsaṃ aññatarā.
segments.an6.16:9.4: Yāvatā kho, gahapati, mama sāvikā gihī odātavasanā lābhiniyo ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa, nakulamātā gahapatānī tāsaṃ aññatarā.
segments.an6.16:9.5: Yāvatā kho, gahapati, mama sāvikā gihī odātavasanā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ogādhappattā patigādhappattā assāsappattā tiṇṇavicikicchā vigatakathaṃkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā satthusāsane viharanti, nakulamātā gahapatānī tāsaṃ aññatarā.
segments.an6.16:9.6: Lābhā te, gahapati, suladdhaṃ te, gahapati!
segments.an6.16:9.7: Yassa te nakulamātā gahapatānī anukampikā atthakāmā ovādikā anusāsikā”ti.

lines: Etadavocāti sāmikassa bhesajjaṃ katvā byādhiṃ vūpasametuṃ asakkontī idāni sīhanādaṃ naditvā saccakiriyāya byādhiṃ vūpasametuṃ santike nisīditvā etaṃ “mā kho tvan”tiādivacanaṃ avoca.
Na nakulamātāti ettha na-kāro na sakkhatīti evaṃ parapadena yojetabbo.
Veṇiṃ olikhitunti eḷakalomāni kappetvā vijaṭetvā veṇiṃ kātuṃ.
Soḷasa vassāni gahaṭṭhakaṃ brahmacariyaṃ samāciṇṇanti ito soḷasavassamatthake gahaṭṭhabrahmacariyavāso samāciṇṇo.
Imehi tīhi aṅgehi sīhanādaṃ naditvā “iminā saccena tava sarīre byādhi phāsu hotū”ti saccakiriyaṃ akāsi.
Idāni bhagavantaṃ sakkhiṃ katvā attano sīlādiguṇehipi saccakiriyaṃ kātuṃ siyā kho pana tetiādimāha.
Aparappaccayāti parappaccayo vuccati parasaddhā parapattiyāyanā, tāya virahitāti attho.
Imehi tīhi aṅgehi attano guṇe ārabbha saccakiriyaṃ akāsi.
Chaṭṭhe visabhāgavedanuppattiyā kakaceneva catuiriyāpathaṃ chindanto ābādhayatīti ābādho, so yassa atthīti ābādhiko.
Sappaṭibhayakantārasadisā soḷasavatthukā aṭṭhavatthukā ca vicikicchā tiṇṇā imāyāti tiṇṇavicikicchā.
Vigatā samucchinnā pavattiādīsu “evaṃ nu kho na nu kho”ti evaṃ pavattikā kathaṃkathā assāti vigatakathaṃkathā.
Sārajjakarānaṃ pāpadhammānaṃ pahīnattā rāgavikkhepesu sīlādiguṇesu ca tiṭṭhakattā vesārajjaṃ, visāradabhāvaṃ veyyattiyaṃ pattāti vesārajjappattā.
Attanā eva paccakkhato diṭṭhattā na paraṃ pacceti, nassa paro paccetabbo atthīti aparappaccayā.
